chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Musa ibn Ja'far from Ubayd Allah from Valid ibn Sulayman and from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There is no prayer whose time arrives except that an angel calls out before the people,
O people, stand up! Extinguish the fire which you have lighted on your backs with your prayer.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of performing prayers on time according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, the Prophet (s.a.w.s.) uses the metaphor of 'fire on one’s back' to describe the spiritual burden of sins, urging believers to extinguish it through timely prayer. This imagery draws upon the Quranic concept of sins weighing down the sinner, framing Salah not merely as ritual but as an active mechanism for spiritual purification and relief from divine accountability.
